feedback.text: Hi, I was charged twice for my Pro subscription on September 25th - two charges of $49 each. I only have one account. Can you please refund the extra charge? Thanks.

classification.rationale: The feedback states 'I was charged twice for my Pro subscription' and requests a refund, indicating a billing issue with significant impact that needs same-day action.

summary: The customer, Bob Tran, reports being charged twice for his Pro subscription on September 25th and requests a refund for the extra charge. Order history confirms two separate paid orders of $49 each for the same plan on that date, indicating a duplicate charge.
customer_context: Customer record found: Bob Tran (C002), Pro plan, single seat, monthly spend $49, 15 months tenure. Two paid orders for the Pro plan on September 25th ($49 each, ORD-9120 and ORD-9121) confirm the duplicate charge. No open tickets; previous support contact was unrelated.

references.title: Handling Billing Issues
references.relevance: Specifies steps for verifying duplicate charges and issuing refunds per policy.

references.title: Refund Policy
references.relevance: Allows full refund for duplicate charges regardless of the 14-day window; no approval needed for refunds under $500.

suggested_actions.action: Issue a full refund of $49 for the duplicate Pro plan charge on September 25th and notify the customer of the expected processing time (5-10 business days).
Confirm to the customer that the duplicate charge has been refunded and provide details on the refund amount and processing timeline.
